title: @dogtrax keep trying but not finding my poem can't grasp fleeting peace that settles in on Kady Did Cackles as stars straggle kecklling hope around ou
summary: @dogtrax keep trying but not finding my poem can't grasp fleeting peace that settles in on Kady Did Cackles as stars straggle kecklling hope around our blue pebble #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
@dogtrax
keep trying
but not finding
my poem
can't grasp
fleeting peace
that settles in
on Kady Did
Cackles
as stars
straggle
kecklling
hope
around our
blue pebble
#smallpoems
